experiments.scope: The exact sha3-256-r6-prefix-v1 target. Once per run the program checks its 6-round SHA3-256 against two known-answer digests of the organizer reference and its 24-round version against hashlib.sha3_256, checks rank 40 of W40 and recomputes the 780 basis-pair two-round polarizations of Lemma 3 (a failed check stops it). Trials 256g..256g+255 form one group: group index h = int(seed of the group's first trial, 16) mod G and trial k is lane c = k mod 256 of the cosets j = 256h + c (proof.md Section 6.1). The leader step draws each coset origin t_j from two random words taken from the trial's own coins; here they are the two halves of SHAKE-256 of the trial's seed, a reproducible stand-in for the cost model's random-word primitive and not the attack's randomness source. The trials of a group share one table, so they are not independent repetitions. The group executes the schedule of proof.md Sections 5 to 7 at reduced size: the first 2^9 Gray points of each coset with degree bound 8, all 175 planes, the full 140-bit key, chi fused into the transpose tiles, the sparse-set table with 2^17 candidates whose sparse words start with arbitrary content, and native verification of key matches. Every operation runs through a counting machine and the program stops unless each executed count equals the formula of proof.md. Beside the algorithm, at point i the message of lane i mod 256 is hashed natively and its 140 key bits compared with the emitted key.
experiments.hypothesis: No trial returns a pair: a 256-bit collision among 2^17 messages has probability below 2^-222. The run shows that the shipped program executes the schedule end to end on the target with the declared operation counts. Its 16 untrusted numbers satisfy: own_pairs16 (per trial) = the number of unordered pairs of the trial's 512 candidates whose keys agree on 16 digest bits (uniform digests give 1.996 per trial and 511 per 256 trials); the other 15 are the same for every trial of a group: fes_ops = 1254554; chi_transpose_ops = 2383872 (4656 per point); point_zero_loads = 175; table_ops = 11 (131072 - x) + 15 x with x = in_range_mismatches (a valid hit also costs 11); dense_count = 131072 - m with m = key_matches; leader_ops = 2821 (11 per coset and 5 per group); evaluation_ops = 1087714; conversion_ops = 224350; transform_phase_ops = 2419200; verify_check_ops at most 3761; perm_calls = 0 (verification evaluates the six rounds in word operations); native_checks = 512; key_mismatch = 0. Nothing about cost is inferred from the run; own_pairs16 is a 16-bit check of premise H_coset on the trials' own digests, not evidence at 256 bits.
